liner.body_md:
## The recordings

- **gd1969-09-26.aud.cotsman.9376.shnf** (recommended): audience recording; 5 songs; 45 min; rated 1.5/5 by 4 [1]. Said about its sound: The tape was used twice, audible throughout King Bee and unmistakable at 6:12 of Death Don't [12]
- **gd69-09-26.aud.hanno.14856.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 5 songs; 44 min; rated 1.89/5 by 9 [2]. Said about its sound: The VBR stream and .ogg files were not really listenable in a conventional sense; The recording quality is poor, but the performance features lightning-fast guitar and Jerry on fire; The recording has very little audience noise, though the quality is not that good [3][5][9][10]

## Around the show

- Jerry used ketamine backstage, improvised new lyrics calling it Lone Star, and claimed it sounded like Willie [6]
- The 1970 Mammoth Gardens show is considered the best of this sort of audience recording [9]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1969-09-26.aud.cotsman.9376.shnf**: transferred by Jack Warner, Joe Jupille and Jeff Cotsman; source: AUD>?>R>CD>EAC>SHN [1]. Also: Sound Forge corrected pitch and minor edits; beginning of Dark Star is cut by a couple minutes; A splice in Eleven at 0:55 indicates perhaps a minute is missing [1]
- **gd69-09-26.aud.hanno.14856.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Uli Teute and Hanno Bunjes; source: Audience [2]. Also: Quality worsens at about 23 minutes; the uploader is unsure which tape actually sounds better [2]
